newsitem.title: USA: Craig Consumer Electronics says delisted.
newsitem.headline: Craig Consumer Electronics says delisted.

text.p: Craig Consumer Electronics Inc said Thursday that it received definitive notice of its ineligibility for continued trading on the NASDAQ National Market.
The company said it failed to meet the quantitative criteria for continued listing on the NASDAQ National Market and, as a result, is no longer eligible for trading on that market.
The company said it continues to negotiate with lending sources to replace its existing line of credit which matures on August 5, and which is subject to various defaults.
To date, replacement financing has not been obtained and management cannot estimate whether any extension or other moratorium will be made available, said a news release issued by the company.
